subject.title: feat(gateway): let write-scope operators manage chat session organization

question: Should `operator.write` clients be allowed to mutate only chat-organization fields through the existing `sessions.patch` method?
rationale: This changes the authorization boundary for a gateway method that also carries admin-level session model, routing, tool inheritance, and spawn metadata fields, so automation should not approve it as routine cleanup.

options.title: Approve Field-Allowlisted Dynamic Scope
options.body: Land this PR's dynamic `sessions.patch` policy, where organization fields use `operator.write` and every other field remains admin-only.

options.title: Require A Dedicated Organization RPC
options.body: Ask for a separate write-scoped session organization method if maintainers do not want dynamic authorization on the broader `sessions.patch` method.

options.title: Keep Admin-Only For Now
options.body: Defer the gateway permission change and keep bounded clients blocked from session organization until the product/security boundary is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve Field-Allowlisted Dynamic Scope
recommendation.body: Land this PR's dynamic `sessions.patch` policy, where organization fields use `operator.write` and every other field remains admin-only.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the canonical tracker and merged session-management feature and are the clearest maintainer for the product/security boundary choice.
